$comment: Expected on-chain state for the canary-sponsored DVN deployment.
Everything the script asserts lives here — the code contains no magic numbers.
REQUIRED BEFORE FIRST RUN: replace the PASTE_SIGNER placeholder(s) below with the
real Canary DVN signer address(es) and set `quorum` to the expected quorum.
How the signer check proves completeness without scanning events:
signerSize == signers.length  AND  signers(a) == true for every a in signers
=> the on-chain active signer set is exactly this set, nothing more, nothing less.
